integrity: Strict convexity and positive weights guarantee a uniquely defined extension; two-input comparison, tangent witnesses, and explicit endpoints are proved in RESULT.md. Standalone checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result treats positive edge conductances on a one-center finite metric star with unweighted graph distance and real boundary data, for 1<p<infinity. Neither arbitrary trees nor other target metrics are covered; the sharp non-Hilbert constant is a nonattained supremum.
title: A discontinuous Hilbert-exponent transition in weighted star \(p\)-harmonic extension stability
